__name: Keyboard Enhance · 让每一个按键都能变成你的快捷键
English: Keyboard Enhance · Turn every key into your own shortcut

__name: 在浏览器中打开项目主页
English: Open the project page in your browser

__name: 每次启动时静默检查，有新版本会先询问再下载
English: Check silently at every launch; ask before downloading a new version

__name: 什么是 GitHub 个人访问令牌（打开官方帮助）
English: What is a GitHub personal access token? (opens official help)

__name: 在浏览器中打开 GitHub 官方中文文档：管理个人访问令牌
English: Open GitHub's official docs in your browser: managing personal access tokens

__name: 个人访问令牌（PAT）相当于给程序用的专用密码：填了之后，本程序以你的账号身份调用 GitHub 接口，配额从每小时 60 次提到 5000 次，还能一键自动下载更新。只读公开仓库不需要勾任何权限。\n\n点这个问号，在浏览器里打开 GitHub 官方说明（含创建步骤）。
English: A personal access token (PAT) is like a dedicated password for this app: once set, the app calls GitHub as your account, raising the quota from 60 to 5000 requests per hour and enabling one-click update downloads. Read-only access to public repositories needs no extra scopes.\n\nClick this question mark to open GitHub's official guide (with creation steps) in your browser.

__name: 已保存时显示为圆点；直接输入或粘贴新令牌就会替换掉旧的
English: Shown as dots once saved; type or paste a new token to replace the old one

__name: 用这个令牌请求一次 GitHub，确认真能用（顺便显示剩余配额）
English: Make one request to GitHub with this token to confirm it works (and show the remaining quota)

__name: 打开 GitHub 的令牌管理页（只需勾选 Public repositories 只读）
English: Open GitHub's token page (only Public repositories read access is needed)

__name: 没有填写 GitHub 个人访问令牌，所以只能提示、不能自动下载。点下面的地址用浏览器下载：
English: No GitHub personal access token is set, so the app can only notify you instead of downloading. Open the address below to download in your browser:

__name: 在默认浏览器里打开发布页（新标签页）
English: Open the release page in your default browser (new tab)

__name: 在浏览器中打开这个版本的 GitHub 下载地址
English: Open this version's GitHub download address in your browser

__name: 打开浏览器下载新版本
English: Open the browser to download the new version
Click to open in your browser

__name: 按键增强（Keyboard Enhance）是一个 Windows 键盘增强工具：按住一个触发键进入功能层，就能把任意按键变成快捷键 —— 光标移动、文字选择、窗口切换、打开网页、播放宏，全部可以自己配。
English: Keyboard Enhance is a Windows keyboard utility: hold a trigger key to enter a function layer, then any key becomes a shortcut — move the cursor, select text, switch windows, open websites, play macros. All of it is up to you.

__name: 支持 10 个独立图层，每层可以有自己的触发键和整套按键绑定。所有配置都在图形界面里完成，也支持 WebDAV 同步与导入导出。
English: Ten independent layers, each with its own trigger key and full set of bindings. Everything is configured in the GUI, with WebDAV sync, import and export.

__name: 本程序的按键语义源自 Junkai Chen 的 AutoHotkey 版 CapsLock+，界面、引擎与全部设置系统为重新实现。
English: The key semantics come from Junkai Chen's AutoHotkey-based CapsLock+; the UI, engine and settings system are a fresh implementation.

__name: 把配置备份到网盘（坚果云等）。启动同步、退出同步、自动备份是三个独立开关，可以同时打开。
English: Back up your settings to cloud storage (Nutstore, etc.). Sync on launch, sync on exit and auto backup are three independent switches that can all be on.

__name: 传上去的是密文（用下面的备份密码加密后才上传），里面包含 GitHub 个人访问令牌这类凭据 —— 换台机器用同一个密码恢复，令牌就一起带过去了。
English: What gets uploaded is ciphertext (encrypted with the backup password below) and it contains credentials such as the GitHub personal access token — restore on another machine with the same password and the token comes along.

__name: 例：https://dav.jianguoyun.com/dav/　（只填到 dav/ 即可；软件会在里面建一个 KeyboardEnhance/ 子目录，点「测连接」时如果还没有会当场建好）
English: e.g. https://dav.jianguoyun.com/dav/  (stop at dav/; the app creates a KeyboardEnhance/ subfolder inside, and "Test connection" will create it if missing)

__name: 坚果云要用「应用密码」，不是登录密码
English: Nutstore needs an app password, not your login password

__name: 没设备份密码 —— 现在不能备份。备份和本地数据都必须加密，设一个密码就能用。
English: No backup password yet — backups are unavailable. Local data and backups must be encrypted; set a password to enable them.

__name: 比云端与本机哪份新，谁新用谁
English: Compare cloud and local copies, use whichever is newer

__name: 退出前把当前配置推上去（最多等 8 秒）
English: Push the current settings before exiting (waits up to 8 seconds)

__name: 清理只动备份文件，不碰当前正在用的配置；两种情况都**至少保留最新一份**。
English: Cleanup only touches backup files, never the settings in use; either way the newest one is always kept.

__name: 列出云端所有备份，挑一份恢复（含时间、大小）
English: List every cloud backup and restore one (with time and size)

__name: 删掉本地和云端早于 7 天的备份
English: Delete local and cloud backups older than 7 days

__name: 本地和云端都只留最新 10 份，其余删掉
English: Keep only the newest 10 both locally and in the cloud, delete the rest

__name: 清掉云端的上传残留、0 字节、重复内容和打不开的文件
English: Remove leftover uploads, zero-byte files, duplicates and unreadable files in the cloud

__name: 备份就放在软件旁边的「KeyboardEnhance Back」文件夹里，拷走整个文件夹就带走了软件和全部备份。
English: Backups live in the "KeyboardEnhance Back" folder next to the app; copy that whole folder and you take the app plus every backup with you.

__name: 软件目录不可写，备份已改放到数据目录。
English: The app folder is not writable, so backups were moved to the data folder.

__name: 本地和云端用同一套规则；最新那份永远保留，不会因为超期被删光。
English: Local and cloud share one rule; the newest backup is always kept and never ages out.

__name: 天前的（0 = 不按天数清）
按间隔自动打包一份；配置没变化就跳过
English: Pack a copy on a timer; skipped when the settings have not changed

__name: 勾了哪一组，就导出那一组的全部内容 —— **GitHub 个人访问令牌也在里面**，换台机器导入后不用重新填。默认加密导出；关掉加密只是不加密文件，不会少东西（网盘密码与备份密码除外）。
English: Whatever group you tick, that group's full contents are exported — **including the GitHub personal access token**, so you need not re-enter it after importing on another machine. Encryption is on by default; turning it off only leaves the file unencrypted, nothing is dropped (apart from the WebDAV and backup passwords).

__name: 用备份密码加密，含 GitHub 令牌 / 全部配置。换台机器导入时输入同一个密码即可。
English: Encrypted with the backup password; includes the GitHub token and all settings. Enter the same password when importing elsewhere.

__name: 加密导出和明文导出都能导入（加密的会问你要密码）。\n导入是合并式的：只覆盖导出文件里包含的那些项。
English: Both encrypted and plain exports can be imported (encrypted ones ask for the password).\nImport merges: only the items present in the file are overwritten.

__name: 两个互不干扰的剪贴板
Caps+C / V 用剪贴板 1，Caps+LAlt+C / V 用剪贴板 2，不会覆盖系统剪贴板里的内容。
English: Caps+C / V uses clipboard 1 and Caps+LAlt+C / V uses clipboard 2, without trampling the system clipboard.

__name: 让每一个按键，都能变成你的快捷键
English: Turn every key into your own shortcut

__name: 按住触发键就是功能键：字母键移动 / 选择光标，数字键切换窗口，Q 打开搜索面板。
English: Hold the trigger key and it becomes a function key: letters move or select the caret, digits switch windows, Q opens the search panel.

__name: 按住触发键即可使用全部功能
English: Hold the trigger key to use every feature

__name: 建议开启，开机即可使用

English: Up and running in three steps

__name: 不用记命令，也不用改配置文件。
English: No commands to memorise, no config files to edit.

__name: 按住触发键再按 S / D / E / F，光标会按字符移动；配合 H / J / K / L 是选择。
English: Hold the trigger key and press S / D / E / F to move the caret by character; add H / J / K / L to select.

__name: 按 Caps+Q：输入程序名直接回车启动，输入关键词回车搜索，输入 =1+2*3 直接算结果。
English: Press Caps+Q: type an app name and Enter to launch, a keyword and Enter to search, or =1+2*3 to calculate.
Change it to your own habits

__name: 「按键映射」里点任意一项即可换成别的功能，改完立刻生效，不用重启。
English: Click any entry on "Key mapping" to swap in another function — it takes effect instantly, no restart.

__name: 再看下面的按键 —— 未绑定的键可以到「按键映射」里自己加。
English: Then look at the keys below — unbound keys can be added on "Key mapping".

__name: 图层、触发键、子层、宏、窗口绑定…（点开查看）
English: Layers, trigger keys, sub-layers, macros, window binding… (click to expand)

__name: 点击键盘上任意键即可编辑它的功能，修改立即生效
English: Click any key on the keyboard to edit its function; changes apply immediately

__name: 选一个当作默认大小；这就是这个页面能缩到的最小尺寸
English: Pick one as the default size; it is also the smallest this page can shrink to

__name: 配置这一层要用哪些修饰键作为子层（最多 10 个）
English: Choose which modifier keys act as sub-layers in this layer (up to 10)

__name: 执行一次这个功能（可能影响当前窗口）
English: Run this function once (may affect the current window)

__name: 搜索功能名、分类、宏名或网址，例如 删除 / 宏 / github
English: Search action names, categories, macro names or URLs, e.g. delete / macro / github

__name: 鼠标变成准星，点哪个窗口就绑哪个程序
English: The cursor turns into a crosshair; click a window to bind that app

__name: 从资源管理器挑一个 exe（程序没在运行也能绑）
English: Choose an exe in Explorer (works even if the app is not running)

__name: 点选窗口：鼠标变准星，点哪个窗口就绑哪个；选择程序文件：从资源管理器挑 exe（程序没在运行也能绑）。
English: Pick a window: the cursor becomes a crosshair, click one to bind it. Choose program file: pick an exe in Explorer (works even if the app is not running).

__name: 给这个链接起个好记的名字，会显示在键帽上
English: Give this link a memorable name; it shows on the keycap

__name: 目标（网址 / 文件夹 / 文件，自动识别）
网址（https://github.com 或不带 http 的 github.com）、文件夹、文件都能填，类型自动识别
English: Accepts a URL (https://github.com or github.com without the scheme), a folder or a file — the type is detected automatically

__name: 从资源管理器里挑一个文件夹
从资源管理器里挑一个文件
再抓一次那个网页的标题
网址、文件夹、文件都填在这里，类型自动识别，不用自己选。填网址会自动抓网页标题当备注；路径不填备注时用文件夹名或文件名。备注会显示在键帽上。
English: Put a URL, folder or file here — the type is detected automatically. For a URL the page title is fetched as the note; for a path the folder or file name is used when the note is empty. The note shows on the keycap.

__name: 给这段文字起个好记的名字，会显示在键帽上
English: Give this text a memorable name; it shows on the keycap

__name: 备注会显示在键帽上；不填就显示文字开头几个字。
English: The note shows on the keycap; if empty, the first few characters do.

__name: 触发这个键时，会把这里的内容直接输入到当前光标处
English: Pressing this key types this text at the current caret

__name: 支持中文与 emoji；不会动你的剪贴板。可以多行（会带换行一起输入）。
English: Chinese and emoji supported; your clipboard is untouched. Multiple lines are fine (line breaks are typed too).

__name: 点一下，然后在键盘上按你想发给应用的键（支持 Ctrl / Shift / Alt 组合）
English: Click here, then press the key you want to send to the app (Ctrl / Shift / Alt combos supported)

__name: 给这个键起个好记的名字，会显示在键帽上
English: Give this key a memorable name; it shows on the keycap

__name: 要接收这个键的程序，例如 C:\\Program Files\\Tencent\\Weixin\\Weixin.exe
English: The app that receives this key, e.g. C:\\Program Files\\Tencent\\Weixin\\Weixin.exe

__name: 从资源管理器里挑一个 exe
仅在需要拉起这个程序时生效，会弹一次 UAC 确认。程序本来就在跑时不受影响。
English: Only applies when the app has to be launched, which triggers one UAC prompt. No effect if the app is already running.

__name: 仅拉起程序时生效，会弹一次 UAC。
English: Only when launching the app; shows one UAC prompt.
Bring the main window to the foreground

__name: 关（默认）：不动它的窗口，按键直接交给系统 —— 应用把这个键注册成全局热键时，在后台也能收到。\n开：先把它的主窗口切到前台再发键，适合「这个键只在它被激活时才有意义」。会抢走你当前的焦点。
English: Off (default): leave its windows alone and hand the key to the system — if the app registers it as a global hotkey it still receives it in the background.\nOn: bring its main window to the foreground first, which suits keys that only make sense while it is active. This steals your current focus.

__name: 开会抢焦点；关着时后台也能收到热键。
English: On steals focus; off still delivers hotkeys in the background.

__name: 窗口出现不代表能收键盘（程序还在加载界面）。大型软件常常 900 毫秒不够，可以调大；小工具可以调小甚至填 0。
English: A visible window does not mean it can take input (it may still be loading). Big apps often need more than 900 ms; small tools can go lower or even 0.

__name: 窗口出现 ≠ 能收键盘，大软件可调大。
English: A window appearing ≠ ready for input; raise it for big apps.

__name: 清空这里，改用设置页里的调节幅度
English: Empty this to use the step size from Settings

__name: 留空则用程序文件名。可以改成你认得的名字，会显示在键帽上
English: Leave empty to use the exe name. Set something you recognise — it shows on the keycap.

__name: 在这个页面里直接按键即可。按住触发键再按别的键，下面会立刻显示切到了第几层。
English: Just press keys on this page. Hold the trigger key and press another key — the layer it switches to shows up below right away.
Press any key to start testing

__name: 提示：按住触发键不放，界面会在 200ms 后进入层模式；按住期间按其他键会立刻进层。
English: Tip: hold the trigger key and the UI enters layer mode after 200 ms; pressing another key while holding goes in immediately.

__name: 每一行 = 一次真实按键，附带它所在层会执行的动作。只记录真实按键，软件自己注入的不算。
English: Each row is one real key press plus the action its layer performs. Only real presses are logged; keys the app injects are not.

__name: 按住触发键超过阈值即进入它绑定的层；短按则保留原键盘功能。\n每个触发键可绑定不同层，层与层之间按键互不干扰。
English: Hold the trigger key past the threshold to enter its layer; a short tap keeps the key's normal function.\nEach trigger key can bind to a different layer, and layers never interfere with each other.

__name: 每一项直接显示：按哪个键、进第几层、怎么进层。
English: Each row says which key, which layer, and how the layer is entered.

__name: 先在左边选一个触发键
English: Select a trigger key on the left first

__name: 按一下目标键即可更换触发键
English: Press the target key to change the trigger key

__name: 按住超过这个时间才进入层；在此之前松开 = 短按，走下面的短按动作。
English: Holding longer than this enters the layer; releasing earlier counts as a tap and runs the tap action below.

__name: 按住触发键时按别的键，立即进层
English: Enter the layer immediately when another key is pressed while holding

__name: 推荐开启。否则每次按组合键都要先等满上面的阈值，手感会明显发涩。
English: Recommended. Without it every combo waits out the threshold above, which feels sluggish.

__name: 双击动作（留空 = 关闭双击）
每层的按键绑定在「按键映射」页编辑；从这里跳过去会自动切到对应层。
English: Bindings are edited on the Key mapping page; jumping there switches to the matching layer.

__name: 录一段操作，绑到任意按键上。
English: Record a sequence and bind it to any key.

__name: 还没有宏\n点「开始录制」，或点下面「＋ 新建」
English: No macros yet\nClick "Start recording", or "+ New" below

__name: 停止正在播放的宏（按 Esc 也可以）
English: Stop the macro that is playing (Esc works too)

__name: 绑定：按键映射 → 功能 → 宏 → 播放宏：xxx。参数栏填数字可临时覆盖重复次数。
English: Binding: Key mapping → Function → Macros → Play macro: xxx. A number in the argument field overrides the repeat count.

__name: 点「开始录制」后照常操作键盘，按键会立刻出现在下面。录制期间不影响正常输入。
English: After "Start recording" just type as usual — keys appear below immediately. Recording does not affect normal input.

__name: 丢掉这次录制，不生成宏
English: Discard this recording without creating a macro

__name: 播放几次。0 = 一直循环，直到按 Esc
English: How many times to play. 0 = loop until Esc

__name: 还没有步骤\n点上面「开始录制」，或用下面的按钮手动插入
English: No steps yet\nClick "Start recording" above, or insert steps with the buttons below

__name: 点一行选中它，插入会插到它后面
English: Click a row to select it; the insert goes after it

__name: 停止后这些会变成可编辑的步骤
English: These become editable steps after you stop

__name: 提示：录制期间按键照常传给当前程序，不会吞键；间隔超过 15ms 会记成一次等待。
English: Tip: while recording keys still reach the current app — nothing is swallowed. Gaps over 15 ms become wait steps.

__name: Qbar：一个输入框搞定搜索、启动、计算
English: Qbar: one box for search, launching and math

__name: 按 Caps+Q 打开。输入 bd 关键词 搜索、输入程序名回车启动、输入 =1+2*3 直接算。
English: Press Caps+Q to open. Type "bd keyword" to search, an app name and Enter to launch, "=1+2*3" to calculate.
(Select an entry on the left, or click Add)

__name: 图片（png/ico）或 exe 路径；留空则自动使用程序图标
English: An image (png/ico) or an exe path; empty uses the app icon

__name: 预览 Preview 文字测试 qgp
这些选项会立刻保存，不需要重启程序。
English: These options save immediately; no restart needed.

__name: 登录 Windows 后自动在托盘运行
English: Runs in the tray after you sign in to Windows

__name: 关闭窗口时最小化到托盘
English: Minimise to tray when the window closes

__name: 保留热键继续工作；从托盘菜单可以完全退出
English: Hotkeys keep working; exit completely from the tray menu
Open the settings window at launch

__name: 关闭后只在托盘运行，按 Caps+Q 依然可用
English: Off means tray-only, and Caps+Q still works

__name: 例如切换置顶、复制到剪贴板时，在屏幕角落提示一下
English: For example when toggling always-on-top or copying to the clipboard, flash a hint in the screen corner

__name: 开启后下次启动会弹一次 UAC 确认；关闭则一直以普通权限运行
English: On shows one UAC prompt at the next launch; off keeps running with normal privileges

__name: 每次启动软件时先要求输入密码，正确才进入主界面
English: Ask for a password at every launch and only open the main UI when it is correct

__name: 开启时需要先设置一个新密码；关闭时需要验证当前密码
English: Turning it on requires a new password; turning it off requires the current one

__name: 自动更新装上新版后，在屏幕角落提示一句「已更新到 x.x.x」
English: After an auto-update installs a new build, flash "Updated to x.x.x" in the screen corner

__name: 每次组合键生效时在屏幕角落闪一下功能名，用来确认按键有没有被识别
English: Flash the action name in the screen corner whenever a combo fires, so you can tell whether the key was recognised

__name: 不按其他键、直接松开 Caps 时的行为
English: What happens when you release Caps without pressing another key

__name: 「输入文本」怎么把文字打进光标处。默认「自动」：长文本走剪贴板粘贴（粘完把剪贴板还原），短文本英文走真实按键（密码框也认）、中文走 Unicode 注入；中文输入法开着时会临时切到英文输入，打完自动切回。密码框仍打不进时改选「真实按键」（此时长文本也逐字敲，可能被程序吞字）。
English: How "Type text" gets characters into the caret. The default "Auto" pastes long text via the clipboard (restoring it afterwards), sends short Latin text as real key strokes (works in password boxes) and injects Chinese via Unicode; with a Chinese IME active it temporarily switches to English input and back. __name: 触发键只能是单个按键 —— 组合键留给层内绑定用，避免「同样按 Ctrl+K，到底算触发还是算绑定」的歧义。
English: A trigger key must be a single key — combos are reserved for layer bindings, so there is no ambiguity about whether Ctrl+K triggers a layer or runs a binding.

__name: 当前配置：{0} 个启用的触发键。
进入某一层后，再按住修饰键（Ctrl / Shift / Alt / Win 及其组合），可以用到**另一套独立绑定**。
English: Inside a layer, holding a modifier (Ctrl / Shift / Alt / Win or a combination) gives you **a second independent set of bindings**.

__name: 每层最多 10 个子层，在「按键映射」页点「设置子层…」自由勾选。
English: Up to 10 sub-layers per layer; tick them under "Configure sub-layers…" on "Key mapping".

__name: 例：基础层按 Q 打开面板，按住 Ctrl 再按 Q 则可以是「删除前一个单词」。
English: For example: Q opens the panel in the base layer, while Ctrl+Q can delete the previous word.

__name: 每个子层都有独立的按键绑定，互不覆盖。
English: Each sub-layer has its own bindings and none of them overwrite each other.

__name: 左半是完整 108 键键盘：点任意键即可编辑它的功能，修改立刻生效。
English: The left half is a full 108-key keyboard: click any key to edit its function, and changes apply at once.

__name: 深蓝色键帽 = 已绑定功能；浅蓝色 = 未绑定。键帽上方的小字是**功能分类**，中间是功能名，下方是键名。
English: Dark blue keycaps are bound; light blue are unbound. The small text above a keycap is its **category**, the middle is the action name and the bottom is the key name.

__name: 右侧「编辑绑定」顶部的搜索框可以按功能名、分类、宏名、网址快速找到要绑的功能。
English: The search box at the top of "Edit binding" on the right finds actions by name, category, macro name or URL.

__name: 「分类」决定功能下拉里显示哪一类；「窗口绑定」「直达链接」「输入文本」这三类会换成专用的编辑界面。
English: Category decides which group the function drop-down shows; "Window binding", "Direct links" and "Type text" switch to a dedicated editor.

__name: 分类选「窗口绑定」后，有两个按钮：点选窗口（准星点一下已开的窗口）或选择程序文件。
English: With "Window binding" selected there are two buttons: pick a window (click an open window with the crosshair) or choose a program file.

__name: 绑定后按该键：程序没开就自动启动，已开着就切过去，已经在前台再按一次会最小化。
English: Once bound, pressing the key launches the app if needed, switches to it if it is open, and minimises it if it is already in front.

__name: exe 名不一定是软件名（idea64.exe 是 IDEA），可以在「显示名称」里改成你认得的名字。
English: An exe name is not always the product name (idea64.exe is IDEA); rename it to something you recognise under "Display name".

__name: 这里有两种用法，别混：一种是「先填好、按键就开」，一种是「选中什么就开什么」。
English: Two different uses — do not mix them up: "fill it in and the key opens it" and "open whatever is selected".

__name: 【先填好】分类选「直达链接」，再选类型：直达网址用默认浏览器打开，直达文件夹在资源管理器里打开，直达文件用系统默认程序打开（和双击一样）。
English: [Fill it in] Choose "Direct links", then a type: a direct URL opens in the default browser, a direct folder in Explorer, a direct file in its default app (like double-clicking).

__name: 网址写成 github.com 也行，会自动补 https://；填完会自动抓网页标题当备注。文件夹和文件都能点「浏览…」直接挑。
English: A URL can be written as github.com; https:// is added automatically, and the page title is fetched as the note. Folders and files can be picked with "Browse…".

__name: 路径支持 %USERPROFILE%\\Desktop、~\\Downloads、shell:Downloads 这些写法；备注会显示在键帽上，不写备注时显示域名 / 文件夹名 / 文件名。
English: Paths accept %USERPROFILE%/Desktop, ~/Downloads and shell:Downloads; the note shows on the keycap, and without one the domain / folder name / file name is used.

__name: 【选中什么就开什么】分类选「智能直达」（这一类里只有它一个动作）：在任意程序里选中一段文字，按这个键 —— 是网址就开浏览器、是文件夹就开资源管理器、是文件就用默认程序打开。不用预先配置。
English: [Open whatever is selected] Choose "Smart open" (the only action in that category): select some text in any app and press this key — a URL opens the browser, a folder opens Explorer, a file opens in its default app. No setup needed.

__name: 智能识别支持带协议的网址、裸域名、盘符路径、UNC 网络路径、环境变量路径，以及 file:/// 开头的地址；选中普通句子时会明确告诉你「这不是链接」，不会乱开浏览器。
English: Detection covers URLs with a scheme, bare domains, drive paths, UNC network paths, environment-variable paths and file:/// addresses; selecting an ordinary sentence tells you plainly that it is not a link instead of opening the browser.

__name: 分类选「自定义按键」：设一个要发送的键 + 一个应用。按这个键时先看应用在不在运行 —— 在运行就直接把键发过去，没运行就先启动它、等窗口出来再发。
English: Choose "Custom key": set a key to send plus an app. Pressing the key first checks whether the app is running — if so the key goes straight to it, otherwise the app is launched and the key is sent once its window appears.

__name: 典型用法：把 F13 绑给微信，按一下就切到微信并按 F13；或者把某个键绑给常驻的笔记软件，按下去直接在里面触发它的快捷键。
English: Typical use: bind F13 to WeChat and one press switches to WeChat and sends F13; or bind a key to an always-on notes app and trigger its shortcut from anywhere.

__name: 「以管理员身份启动」只在需要拉起这个程序时生效，会弹一次 UAC；程序本来就在跑时不受影响。
English: Launch as administrator only applies when the app has to be launched, and shows one UAC prompt; a running app is unaffected.

__name: 「把应用主窗口切到前台」默认关：不动它的窗口，按键直接交给系统（应用把它注册成全局热键时后台也能收到）；开了会先切前台再发键，但会抢走焦点。
English: Bring the app's main window to the foreground is off by default: its windows are left alone and the key goes to the system (so a global hotkey still registers in the background). Turning it on brings the window forward first, but steals focus.

__name: 「启动后等多久再发键」默认 900 毫秒 —— 窗口出现不代表能收键盘，大型软件要调大。
English: How long to wait before sending defaults to 900 ms — a visible window does not mean it accepts input, and big apps need more.

__name: 备注会显示在键帽上；不填时显示绑定的应用名。
English: The note shows on the keycap; without one the bound app's name is used.

__name: 分类选「直接搜索」，再挑一个搜索引擎（百度、知乎、B站、Google…）。
English: Choose "Direct search", then pick a search engine (Bing, Baidu, Google…).

__name: 用法：在任意程序里选中一段文字，按这个键 —— 直接用该引擎在默认浏览器里搜索。
English: Usage: select some text in any app and press this key to search for it with that engine in your default browser.

__name: 不经过 Qbar 面板，是「看到就查」的最快路径。没选中文字时会提示先选中。
English: It skips the Qbar panel — the fastest path when you see something and want to look it up. With nothing selected it tells you to select something first.

__name: 它和「Qbar 搜索」的区别：Qbar 搜索是打开面板再输入；直接搜索是拿选区直接搜。
English: How it differs from "Qbar search": Qbar search opens the panel for you to type; direct search searches the selection as is.

__name: 「宏」页可以录制一串按键操作，然后把整个宏绑到一个键上。
English: The "Macros" page records a sequence of key presses, then binds the whole macro to one key.

__name: 录制中的按键不会被拦截，录完在列表里可以调整每一步的延迟。
English: Keystrokes are not intercepted while recording, and each step's delay can be tuned in the list afterwards.

__name: 绑定时分类选「宏」，再从功能下拉里选具体那个宏。
English: When binding, choose the "Macros" category and then the specific macro from the function drop-down.

__name: 内置 10 组独立剪贴板（Caps+C / Caps+V 那一套），与系统剪贴板分开。
English: Ten separate clipboards are built in (the Caps+C / Caps+V set), kept apart from the system clipboard.

__name: 所有用户数据都在软件旁边的「KeyboardEnhance Data」文件夹里，备份在「KeyboardEnhance Back」里 —— 拷走整个文件夹就带走了软件和全部数据。
English: All user data lives in the "KeyboardEnhance Data" folder next to the app, with backups in "KeyboardEnhance Back" — copy that folder and you take the app plus all data.

__name: 本地数据一律加密（AES-256-GCM），密钥由「备份密码」派生；没设密码时是明文，设了会立刻转成密文。
English: Local data is always encrypted (AES-256-GCM) with a key derived from the backup password; without a password it stays plaintext, and setting one converts it immediately.

__name: 「同步与备份」支持 WebDAV：可以把整套配置同步到网盘，也能导入导出。导出默认加密、含全部字段；关掉加密则是明文，会剔除密码类字段。
English: Sync and backup supports WebDAV: the whole configuration can be synced to cloud storage, imported and exported. Exports are encrypted and complete by default; disabling encryption makes them plaintext and strips password fields.

__name: 改了按键没生效？确认当前在正确的层（看键盘上方的层下拉），以及引擎没有处于「暂停」状态。
English: Changed a key and nothing happened? Check that you are in the right layer (see the layer drop-down above the keyboard) and that the engine is not paused.

__name: 锁屏（Win+L）后热键失效是系统限制 —— 锁屏界面在独立的安全桌面上，任何程序都无法在上面拦截键盘。
English: Hotkeys not working after locking (Win+L) is a system limit — the lock screen runs on a separate secure desktop where no app can intercept the keyboard.

__name: 开机自启在「设置」里开关；它写入的是当前用户的注册表，不需要管理员权限。
English: Start with Windows is toggled in Settings; it writes to the current user's registry and needs no administrator rights.
